cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; A secluded river bathing pavilion with sunlit limestone steps and a wicker basket for towels — She sets her folded swimming robe on a warm ledge before checking the water temperature with her toes; a training gym with a heavy bag — standing; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — seated on a chair; A bamboo-slip conservation studio with shallow sorting trays — She matches a broken half of a wooden tally to its mate before tying the two halves together for storage; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — adjusts the height of the stand holding a microphone; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a wind-rippled desert dune trail — lying on her left side; a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead — standing; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing with one foot up on a step; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — perched on a ledge or edge; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — holds her keepsake up beside her face
